reviews.text: Ella was excellent with my puppy's first visit to Martins

Always caring professional staff. Informative on charges and treatments .Tilly has dry eye and is 13 years old ( she was my mum’s dog) , only has 3 teeth left but is treated with love by all the staff which is reassuring.
Fantastic gentle care given to my dog every visit excellent staff very professional wouldn't go anywhere else.
Always a pleasant experience. Bets are all lovely and very caring towards my dogs. Would definitely recommend!
As always a top class veterinarian centre. Can't fault the guys for their thoroughness in the care of Rocco anytime we visit, definitely recommend!!

Thank you so much for your work. I remember how excited we were when Dr. Alistair extracted our dog's tooth, how he performed eye surgery on our Chow Chow, and everything always ended very well. I like all the doctors at your clinic, because every visit always produced a good result. Thank you so much for your excellent work. Our friends' recommendation to choose this clinic was excellent!
Excellent service, caring and thorough. Very professional environment.
Great vet,been using them for long time,know my dog is in good hands.
Martins veterinary surgery has a friendly, comfortable family atmosphere with a dedicated team happy to help.

We are always treated well and our dog is given a thorough examination. Treatment is discussed and we feel that our dogs health is your priority. We are always given an honest and detailed prognosis on the way forward, and our views are always taken into consideration
I took my 21 year old cat in for a very painful paw.  I got the best treatment and the care my old girl got was exceptional.

Really professional care and kindness shown to Ailsa. She is always happy to see you all.
Thank you all for caring, see you soon.Janice

First class care for my cats, can't recommend too highly!
The health plan is really good value too 👌

All the staff were friendly to me and Toby and made us feel welcome and in safe hands
Many thanks
Kenny

Lottie’s first visit to Martins Vets went so smoothly. She was checked over, had her dew claws clipped and got her jabs. No fuss whatsoever. All was explained very clearly. Appointment was relaxed and we weren’t rushed. No apprehension at all for our next visit!

An excellent vet been going for many years.
Lovely caring friendly staff. Delighted with help and support I got from Irene on Wednesday. Lovely caring lady.
First class service all the staff 100per cent loving caring polite great service
Highly recommended caring and kind and professional will give your pet the best  of care
Thank you for the 5* review Stacey
Had a short notice appointment for our puppy, and he was well looked after. From the welcome he got by the reception ladies to the care he received from Irene, he is in good hands. Thank you so much
Amazing staff the care they give pets is amazing and the prices are great for the treatments etc, I would highly recommend 😀 x
The patience and kindness of the staff was fantastic! My cat was treated like the individual he is and he cooed really well as a result.

My dog recently had a dental procedure at Martin Vet Centre, and the entire experience was fantastic from start to finish. Everything went smoothly and was relatively stress-free. The team took the time to explain everything clearly—from the procedure itself and the risks involved to the exact costs. All of my questions were answered thoroughly. The staff are professional, friendly, and truly caring. Hopefully, your pet won't need a vet visit anytime soon, but if they do, I highly recommend Martin Vet Centre!
thank you for your 5* review.
Staff are always very welcoming and friendly. They treat my dogs very well and always give them plenty of treats and affection.

I have been to see both Emma and Ella in the last week due to concerns for my wee chihuahua Luna.
Both vets have been amazing with Luna seeing me at short notice and reassuring
both myself and Luna when we have been stressed.
They could not have done anymore.
Lovely people,so knowledgable and nothing too much trouble.
Thank you for taking time to review

I cannot thank the team here enough for the incredible care they provided to my Frenchie, Nala. She has Intervertebral Disc Disease (IVDD), which is an incredibly stressful and scary condition to manage as an owner.When we needed help, we were seen promptly without any unnecessary waiting around. The efficiency and speed of the staff made a massive difference in keeping Nala calm. The entire team was absolutely amazing—kind, professional, and deeply understanding of her specific needs.If you are looking for a veterinary practice that combines fast action with genuine compassion, I highly recommend them. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of Nala!
All the staff at MVC are great. Top marks!
Thank you for your 5* review.
Very pleased as the staff care about the pets welfare,

Seen as an “emergency” within 10 minutes of arrival at surgery. Very thorough examination of dog and full explanations of outcome of examination, possible reasons for symptoms, other health concerns identified for ongoing management and treatment for immediate concerns. Detailed explanation of drugs prescribed and possible side effects to be aware of.  Thankfully progress after  several hours noticeable and marked improvement in 24 hours. Been with this vet for over 12 years since relocating to area.
The vets in this practice are super friendly and great with my cat's. Reception staff are always happy to help.

I was hesitant about giving my other dogs their vaccinations (not related to the above) and I was sent out information to help me make an informed decision.
Great. They treated my dog told us the price of the antibiotics but i asked for a vet script which I was given. And got the human alternative so much cheaper

We had to get an emergency appointment for our dog late afternoon yesterday 10th June. Kate on reception was very helpful and Aileen the vet was very caring and diagnosed the problem straight away. We have been with this practice for over 30 yrs and have always found them to be very caring and professional.
Was seen really fast & all the staff was so friendly & helpful would recommend to anyone with a pet to go to this vet.
Staff are very professional, polite and most importantly gave doggy centred care.  Wouldn't hesitate to recommend x

Excellent support from all the staff

Good knowledgeable  staff friendly environment most animals i see when there visiting are happy
Very caring and informative.

After 3 weeks of ownership brought Casey my German Shepherd girl into have Vaccinations, worming tablets and advice because she was bleeding a bit from the rear end  she is in season.
Casey was weighed had her temperature taken not the most pleasant experience for a dog but Irene James the Vet was superb and kept Casey calm and spoilt rotten with treats, so we will be back for all future treatments.  Chose  Martin Vets on recommendations, very glad I did 😀 👍.

Our 3 dogs are rescues and all have anxiety when visiting the vets. The vet that we saw was incredibly patient and was really gentle with our pups which we really appreciated.

I loved how kind and caring the vet was to Fergus also the information they provided to myself.

Thoroughly professional. Greeted warmly by a cheerful vet who made us and more importantly our cat at ease. Have used this Vet Practice for years and would highly recommend them. Easy to get to and has its own dedicated parking facilities.

Always happy with my visits to Martin Veterinary Centre. Lovely staff all round. My dog is always looked after so well.

If you want your pet handled with the utmost care- Martin Vets is the place to go. Martin Vets have always looked after our girl Luna, answered any of our questions and reassured us. This 5* service was particularly evident today when I showed up on the wrong date for an appointment due to a mistake on the online booking system. The lovely ladies at reception tried their best to find any staff available to see Luna so I wouldn't need to wait when she was uncomfortable. Nina then handled Luna perfectly, provided great advice and made us feel well looked after. It is absolutely worth the investment in your pet to bring them here.

I took Ruby for a review of her medication and the possibility of reducing the dosage.
The vet gave her a thorough examination and after discussing Ruby's behaviour agreed that it was worth attempting to reduce the dosage to once a day. She explained what to look out for during the reduction and stated that should I feel concerned that her behavior was being impacted I should return to two a day and contact the practice in order that the situation could be further examined. Throughout the examination the vet was careful to keep Ruby at ease.
I cannot recommend this practice highly enough for the care given to my dogs by both the vets and all the practice staff.
Great service as always. Reception staff & vets are always warm welcoming & friendly. Seen promptly. Been using Martins Vets for years & would highly recommend.
